cases.label: E2E1 EN
cases.draft_answer: Narrow AI, also known as weak AI, is designed to perform specific tasks and operates within a limited domain, making it efficient at solving specialized problems. In contrast, general AI would possess the ability to understand, learn, and apply knowledge across a wide range of tasks, similar to human intelligence. However, general AI has not yet been achieved.

cases.final_answer: Narrow AI, also known as weak AI, is designed to perform specific tasks and operates within a limited domain, making it efficient at solving specialized problems.

cases.label: E2E1 FR
cases.draft_answer: La narrow AI, ou intelligence artificielle étroite, est conçue pour effectuer des tâches spécifiques et représente tous les systèmes d'IA déployés aujourd'hui. Elle opère dans un domaine limité et peut être très efficace pour résoudre des problèmes spécialisés, comme la reconnaissance d'images. En revanche, la general AI, ou intelligence artificielle générale, n'a pas encore été atteinte et se caractérise par sa capacité à généraliser au-delà des fonctions qu'elle a apprises.

cases.label: E2E2
cases.draft_answer: Precision measures the proportion of predicted positives that were correct, while recall measures the proportion of actual positives that are correctly predicted. The F1-score is the harmonic mean of precision and recall, indicating the balance between the two metrics. A high F1-score suggests minimal classification errors, whereas a low score indicates difficulties in accurately identifying positives.

The F1-score is the harmonic mean of precision and recall, indicating the balance between the two metrics. A high F1-score suggests minimal classification errors, whereas a low score indicates difficulties in accurately identifying positives.

cases.label: E2E3
cases.draft_answer: Back-to-back testing helps with the test oracle problem by using an alternative version of the system as a reference point (a pseudo-oracle) and comparing its outputs with those of the system being tested when presented with the same inputs. This approach provides a practical solution to determine the correctness of outputs, especially when well-defined specifications are lacking.

trainer.explanation: Overfitting in machine learning occurs when a model performs significantly worse on the test dataset than on the validation dataset. During testing, overfitting can be detected by evaluating the model’s performance metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, or F1 score, which may be high on the training set but low on the validation set. Visual inspection of learning curves can also help identify overfitting, as the training performance may continue to improve while validation performance stagnates or declines. (S2, S3)
